name: con2tr
title: A contour list stacked the way expand.grid stacks x and y.

origin.description: A contour list stacked the way expand.grid stacks x and y.
origin.value: The value printed in the example.

translation.description: A contour list stacked the way expand.grid stacks x and y.
translation.details: Checked against MASS 7.3-66. NumPy holds the arrays where the function is numeric.
translation.value: The value printed in the example.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
obj = {'x': [1, 2], 'y': [10, 20, 30], 'z': np.array([[1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]], float)}
out = con2tr(obj)
return out['x'] + out['y'] + out['z']
